name: Skill Creator Agent
description: Workflow for isolating skill-design work in a bounded creator agent that inspects existing tools, creates or updates registered skills, chains multiple tool passes over the same artifact, and returns compact proof to the requesting chat.
triggerPatterns: do not pollute the requesting chat

chain.step: Classify the requested goal and decide whether it needs one skill, a small skill bundle, or an update to an existing skill.
Spawn a bounded skill-creator sub-agent with only the goal, relevant repo paths, existing skill/tool context, write targets, and acceptance checks.
Inside the creator agent, inspect existing skills and exact tool contracts before drafting any workflow.
Create or update compact registered skills with exact tool ids, trigger phrases, chain steps, proof loops, and failure handling.
Run a second pass over the same artifact for trigger coverage, context budget, tool-chain accuracy, and duplicate-skill risk.
Prove the new or updated skill triggers from user-facing sample prompts and report only the summary, files changed, selected skill ids, and verification evidence.
